info.title: vlresports - Valorant Esports API
info.description:
API for scraping Valorant esports data from vlr.gg

**Important:** All IDs (players, teams, events, matches) used in this API correspond to the IDs from vlr.gg. You can find these IDs in the URLs on the vlr.gg website.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all Valorant professional players with optional filters
Retrieve detailed information about a specific player
Retrieve a list of all Valorant professional teams with optional filters
Retrieve detailed information about a specific team
Retrieve Valorant esports events with optional filters

Retrieve full details of an event: header info (dates, prize pool, location), stages, participating teams with rosters, prize distribution and the bracket with its matches. The bracket and teams belong to one stage at a time: by default the stage vlr.gg marks as current (see `stages[].active`), or the one selected with the `stage` parameter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Event ID (numeric, from the vlr.gg event URL)

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Stage slug to select which stage's bracket and teams to return (e.g. `playoffs`, `play-ins`, `group-stage`). Valid slugs are listed in the response's `stages[].slug`. Requesting an unknown stage returns 400 with the valid options.

get.summary: Get all matches of an event
get.description: Retrieve every match of an event, optionally filtered by stage and/or status. Match ids are usable with /api/v1/matches/{id}.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Stage slug to filter by (e.g. `playoffs`). Valid slugs come in the response's `stages` array. Unknown stages return 400 with the valid options.

400.description: Invalid event id, stage or status

get.summary: Get player statistics of an event
get.description: Retrieve the per-player statistics table of an event (rating, ACS, K/D, KAST, ADR, clutches, etc.), optionally for a single stage.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Stage slug to filter by (e.g. `group-stage`). Unknown stages return 400 with the valid options.

get.summary: Get agent utilization of an event
get.description: Retrieve agent pick rates per map for an event, including attack/defense round win rates. Stage filtering is not supported by vlr.gg on this page, so the data always covers the whole event.
Retrieve information about upcoming or live matches

Retrieve full details of a single match: event info, teams, score, status, streams, VODs, picks/bans, per-map results and per-player statistics (overall and per map). Optionally include the performance tab (multikills, clutches, duel matrices) and/or economy tab (buy types, banks, round economy) via the `tabs` query parameter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Match ID (numeric, from the vlr.gg match URL)

parameters.name: tabs
parameters.description: Comma-separated extra vlr.gg tabs to scrape: `performance`, `economy`, or `all` for both. Each tab adds one extra request to vlr.gg, making the response slower. The data appears at the top level (aggregated across all maps) and inside each map object.

get.description: Retrieve information about past match results with pagination

ThemeParam.name: theme
ThemeParam.description: Selects the vlr.gg theme variant used when extracting logos. Some events and teams serve a different logo image for light vs dark mode (e.g. VCT EMEA is black on light, green on dark). Defaults to `light` for backwards compatibility.

playRate.description: Percentage of maps played on this agent

map.description: Map name, or `All` for the aggregate row

circuit.description: Parent circuit the event belongs to (e.g. Valorant Champions Tour)

stages.description: Event stages/phases (e.g. Group Stage, Play-Ins, Playoffs)

slug.description: Slug usable as the `stage` query parameter

active.description: Whether this is the stage the response's bracket and teams belong to

seed.description: Seeding or qualification note (e.g. group and position)

groups.description: Group standings, for group stages. Empty for bracket-only stages (e.g. playoffs)

bracket.description: Bracket columns (rounds) with their matches, for the active stage. Empty for stages without a bracket (e.g. group stages)

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, UTC) of the match

in.description: Countdown until match start (only for upcoming matches, e.g. `2d 8h`)

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, UTC) of the match start

score.description: Running score after the round, e.g. `5-3`

winner.description: Tag of the team that won the round

side.description: Side the round was won on: `t` or `ct`

method.description: How the round was won: `elim` (eliminations), `boom` (spike exploded), `defuse` (spike defused) or `time` (time ran out)

methodIcon.description: Absolute URL of the win-method icon shown on vlr.gg

players.description: Per-player statistics aggregated across all maps

performance.description: Aggregated across all maps. Only present when `tabs` includes `performance`

economy.description: Aggregated across all maps (summary only, no rounds). Only present when `tabs` includes `economy`

killMatrix.description: Head-to-head kills between each player pair

opKillMatrix.description: Head-to-head Operator kills between each player pair

firstKillMatrix.description: Head-to-head first kills/first deaths between each player pair

rounds.description: Round-by-round economy (only for played maps, empty at the aggregated level)

bank.description: Team bank at round start, in credits

loadout.description: Total loadout value of the team that round, in credits

winner.description: Whether this team won the round

total.description: Rounds played with this buy type

won.description: Rounds won with this buy type

img.description: Absolute URL of the agent icon
